It has further, submitted that the Pension and Gratuity fund has been entrusted to a Trust independent of the petitioners management and interest earned thereon is taken care by the trust. The petitioner has submitted that out of total number of work force of petitioners company, both employees and workmen, 98.90% is engaged in power business, and the remaining is engaged in Irrigation, Flood control as on 31.3.2006 and the amount decided as contribution to be made as per the actuarial valuation as on 31.3.2006 was allocated to ‘Power business’ in proportion to the above percentage of employees.
